scope: Public maintenance register, not a private matter source archive or certification of current law.
freshness_fields: Three dates answer different questions. retrieved_at: the day a maintainer last fetched url and saw it answer. page_changed_at: the publication date shown in the currency line of the page at currency_url, or null when no such line is recorded. legally_reviewed_at: the day a qualified reviewer checked the proposition against the law; null until that happens, and never set by a script. currency_url and currency_line record where scripts/check_sources.py reads the page's currency line and the value last seen there. A reachable URL or an unchanged currency line does not establish current law, and neither retrieved_at nor page_changed_at substitutes for last_reviewed or legally_reviewed_at.
